Details 
$sparql = @'
SELECT ?obj ?namedAs (YEAR(?birthDate) AS ?birthYear) (YEAR(?deathDate) AS ?deathYear) 
?web ?bigEnc ?bigEncOld ?orthEnc ?wikisource ?rusBioDict ?azlibru ?wikipedia ?links 
WHERE {
  VALUES ?descBy {
    wd:Q109277663 #XVIII vol1
    wd:Q110027664 #XVIII vol2
    wd:Q110027715 #XVIII vol3
    wd:Q125555255 #XIX vol1
    wd:Q125555366 #XIX vol2
    wd:Q124510026 #XX vol1
    wd:Q124518167 #XX vol2
    wd:Q124518168 #XX vol3
    wd:Q108611244 #spbXX
    #wd:Q124821483 #prodetlit
    #wd:Q125019793 #NLR empl
  }
  ?obj p:P1343 ?stmt.
  ?stmt ps:P1343 ?descBy.
  
  OPTIONAL { ?obj wdt:P569 ?birthDate. }
  OPTIONAL { ?obj wdt:P570 ?deathDate. }
  
  OPTIONAL { ?stmt pq:P1810 ?namedAs. }
   
  OPTIONAL { ?obj wikibase:sitelinks ?links. }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?obj rdfs:label ?objLabel.
    FILTER (LANG(?objLabel) = "ru" )
  }
  BIND(COALESCE(?namedAs, STR(?objLabel)) AS ?namedAs)
  
  OPTIONAL {?stmt pq:P2699 ?web. }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?obj wdt:P2924 ?bigEncOldId.
    wd:P2924 wdt:P1630 ?fmt.
    BIND(IRI(REPLACE(?bigEncOldId, "(^.*)", ?fmt)) AS ?bigEncOld)
  }
  OPTIONAL
  {
    ?obj wdt:P11514 ?bigEncId.
    wd:P11514 wdt:P1630 ?fmt2.
    BIND(IRI(REPLACE(?bigEncId, "(^.*)", ?fmt2)) AS ?bigEnc)
  }
  OPTIONAL
  {
    ?obj wdt:P5002 ?orthEncId.
    wd:P5002 wdt:P1630 ?fmt3.
    BIND(IRI(REPLACE(?orthEncId, "(^.*)", ?fmt3)) AS ?orthEnc)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?obj p:P1343 ?stmt2.
    ?stmt2 pq:P805 ?article.
    ?article wdt:P1433/wdt:P361 wd:Q1960551 .
    ?rusBioDict schema:about ?article .
      ?rusBioDict schema:inLanguage "ru" .
      ?rusBioDict schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikisource.org/> .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?obj wdt:P12614 ?id .
  wd:P12614 wdt:P1630 ?fmt4.
    BIND(IRI(REPLACE(?id, "(^.*)", ?fmt4)) AS ?azlibru)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?articleWs schema:about ?obj .
    ?articleWs schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikisource.org/>.
    BIND(IRI($articleWs) AS ?wikisource).
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?wikipedia schema:about ?obj;
      schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikipedia.org/>.
  }
}
'@
$objs = Invoke-Sparql $sparql
$objs2 = Merge-ObjectsByUniqueId -InputObject $objs -IdProperty obj
$propNames = $objs[0].psobject.properties.name | ogv -PassThru
Add-UrlLabels -InputObject $objs2 -Property $propNames
$objs2 | sort {[int]$_.links} -desc | select @{n='n';e={$script:i++; $script:i}},* | Format-HtmlTable -Description $sparql
